info.name: The Object of Professor Foxwit's Interest

descriptions.notStarted: Professor Foxwit in NLC has a deep interest in the Turkey Commando’s Eye. If you happen to come across any of these eyes, be sure to bring them to Professor Foxwit in NLC.
